selection_rule: Best of initial three; replace on two paired wins and mean gain >= 0.002

ensemble.rule: Best per visited route; max 3 routes; equal probability weights; inner gain >= .002

confirmation.selection_rule: Best of initial three; replace on two paired wins and mean gain >= 0.002

proposal.reason: Trial 1 is the only completed PRIMARY evidence: word C=0.05 scored 0.6448 search accuracy with a 0.1729 train-search gap. The word_char route is untried and C=0.3 is a moderate regularization point, so this tests whether subword features improve generalization over the word-only baseline without committing to a predicted gain.
proposal.review: Only one PRIMARY trial is available. It used word representation with C=0.05 and logistic regression, achieving search accuracy 0.6448, train accuracy 0.8178, and balanced class recalls. No confirmation split is available, and no word_char or C=0.3 evidence exists yet.
proposal.hypothesis: Word_char features may capture character-level cues in headlines that word-only features miss, and C=0.3 may provide a reasonable bias-variance tradeoff. This is a coverage/improvement test, not a guaranteed improvement.
proposal.uncertainty: Only one primary trial exists, so route and regularization behavior are largely unknown. The direction and magnitude of any accuracy change from word_char C=0.3 are uncertain, and single-split measurements may be noisy.
